issue.title: Update package to Angular 9
issue.body:
Hi,
Thanks you for this great package. It has been very helpful for me.
I updated my project to Angular 9, and I received an error from `ng build` for wrong importing the `DateAdapter`, since it should be imported from `@angular/material/core` now.

```
ERROR in node_modules/@tabuckner/material-dayjs-adapter/lib/adapter/dayjs-date-adapter.d.ts:2:29 - error TS2306: File '.../node_modules/@angular/material/index.d.ts' is not a module.

2 import { DateAdapter } from '@angular/material';
```

Can you please update the package in NPM to support it?

body: Closing this issue now as ngcc already supports ignoring these warnings for local packages in `dist`.
Hold on I might have spoken too soon...

We do read that `ngcc.config.js` from the package but currently only parsing the entry-point information from it rather and not the `ignorableDeepImportMatchers` property 😱 

I'll fix it in a PR today.

issue.body:
Recently we added support for ignoring specified deep-import
warnings by providing sets of regular expressions within the
`ngcc.config.js` file. But this was only working for the project
level configuration.

This commit fixes ngcc so that it will also read these regular
expressions from package level configuration too.

Resolves #35750
